title: Multimodal Error Detection in Chest X-ray Reports: A Large Language Model Reading Image Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2611.26492v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Rad-Linter checks chest X-ray reports against image-derived evidence to flag potential errors for review. A pretrained image classifier supplies scores for nine pathologies, and a 1.5B-parameter language model, fine-tuned with LoRA on 1,816 examples, checks their consistency with the report. We compare it with a keyword-and-negation rule baseline given the same reports and scores. Evaluation uses controlled report-score pairings from OpenI, with consistency labels derived from automatic report labels and score thresholds. Each counterfactual quad crosses two real reports with two real score vectors from other patients, creating two consistent and two inconsistent pairs. Every report and score vector occurs in both conditions, so either input alone permits only 50% accuracy. translated_title: 胸部X光报告中的多模态错误检测：一种能够阅读图像证据的大语言模型
translated_abstract: Rad-Linter根据图像衍生的证据检查胸部X光报告，以标记潜在错误供人工审阅。一个预训练的图像分类器为九种病理提供评分，一个15亿参数的语言模型在1,816个样本上通过LoRA微调后，用于检查评分与报告的一致性。研究人员将其与在相同报告和评分条件下的关键词-否定规则基线进行了比较。评估使用来自OpenI数据集的受控报告-评分配对，一致性标签由自动报告标签和评分阈值推导得出。每个反事实四元组将两个真实报告与来自其他患者的两个真实评分向量交叉组合，形成两个一致对和两个不一致对。每个报告和评分向量都出现在两种条件下，因此仅凭任一输入只能达到50%的准确率。在131个四元组上，Rad-Linter达到了98.5%的配对准确率，而规则基线仅为80.5%；在94.4%的四元组中Rad-Linter能正确分类全部四对，而基线仅为56.5%。
tldr: Rad-Linter利用预训练图像分类器的九种病理评分，通过LoRA微调的15亿参数语言模型检查胸部X光报告与图像证据的一致性以标记潜在错误，在受控反事实评估中配对准确率达98.5%，显著优于关键词-否定规则基线的80.5%。
en_tdlr: Rad-Linter uses a LoRA-fine-tuned 1.5B-parameter language model to check chest X-ray reports against image-derived pathology scores from a pretrained classifier, achieving 98.5% pair accuracy on controlled counterfactual evaluations versus 80.5% for a keyword-and-negation rule baseline.
